scope_note: The Diet minutes API's JSON for speech 8 of the 衆議院 本会議 第2号 (1996-01-24), a transcription of the House's printed minutes; the exact API URL whose bytes were hashed is recorded, and the readable minutes page is https://kokkai.ndl.go.jp/txt/113605254X00219960124. The printed page images, served through a JavaScript viewer, were not viewed. Statements are used only where a party officer speaks of the party office. One speech: the representative question of 佐藤観樹 in the House of Representatives plenary of 24 January 1996, which opens with his own statement that he has become 幹事長 of 社会民主党 (a party officer by his own statement; a reply in the same meeting, not recorded here, also addresses him as 佐藤幹事長). Used only for the organization's new name; he speaks for a three-group coalition, which is not imported.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: On 24 January 1996 佐藤観樹 introduces himself as having just become 幹事長 of 社会民主党 ("このたび、社会民主党の幹事長になりました"): a same-day party-officer statement using the organization's new name 社会民主党 (the renaming itself is not mentioned).

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the chair of 日本社会党 (委員長) and, from the January 1996 renaming, the party leader of 社会民主党 (党首), for CLAUDE-C01-29 only, 1990-2026. Party elections and selections, notices, filings, counts and declarations, convention approvals, statements of assumption, in-office attestations, announced, submitted, accepted and withdrawn resignations, stated ends, acting arrangements, predecessor references, the renaming, the 2020 convention decision and retrospective records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this office (a notice, a schedule, a filing by several candidates, an organization event, an acting leader). The prime-ministership (jp_pm), ministerial and Speaker offices, parliamentary groups and other party offices are excluded: no row feeds them, and none of their claims feeds this office. Organization identities stay unresolved; no row maps or merges 日本社会党, 社会民主党 or any other party.
